_meta.name: advderm-tebra-export-records
_meta.description: Navigate Advanced Dermatology & Cosmetic Surgery (Leavitt Management Group) patient portal on Tebra (formerly Kareo) platform, export visit notes, billing statements, and health records.
_meta.platform: Tebra (formerly Kareo) patient portal — NOT MyChart
_meta.provider: Advanced Dermatology & Cosmetic Surgery — Leavitt Management Group
_meta.authStrategy: Email + password. Account email: Mw@mike-wolf.com (note capital M). Portal welcome email Jan 2025 from welcome@practicemailer.com. Activate via Google Chrome (per setup instructions).
anomalies: Tebra (Kareo) portals are web-only — no mobile app
Portal URL may be a subdomain of practicemailer.com or a custom domain — activate link from welcome email has the real URL
Portal update Feb 2025 confirms account is active
Dermatology practice — primary records: visit notes, photos (if digitized), biopsy results, billing

params.note: If portal.practicemailer.com does not resolve, retrieve actual portal URL from the Jan 2025 welcome email (subject: 'Welcome to Your Advanced Dermatology & Cosmetic Surgery (Leavitt Management Group) Patient Portal' from welcome@practicemailer.com)

chain.note: Tebra patient portal. The exact subdomain/URL may differ — retrieve from the welcome email if this redirects unexpectedly.
Halt if login form appears. Mike authenticates manually. Account email: Mw@mike-wolf.com.
Capture Tebra portal navigation. Expect: Appointments, Health Records, Billing, Messages.
Capture records: visit summaries, diagnoses, procedures (dermatology: lesion removals, biopsies, cosmetic procedures), medications, allergies.
Trigger records download / CCDA export if available.
Capture billing statements. Portal update Feb 2025 was likely a new statement notification.
Capture appointment history with dates, provider, visit type.

auth-sentinel.note: Tebra is server-rendered — selectors should be more stable than SPA portals.
